messages:
Bea: Morning team  we're finalizing the launch playbook today. Need: 1) a 1-page SDR cheat (snackable), 2) 3 battlecard zingers vs CloudX/LLMAPI/InfraCo, 3) inbound routing rules to prioritize benchmark/latency leads for the webinar follow-up. 90-minute sprint.

Ibrahim: I can own the battlecard zingers. My suggested leads: predictability of unit economics, deployment parity across modes, and guaranteed fallbacks for overloaded capacity. Keep each line <18 words.

Clara: SDR cheat outline: opener (1 sentence), 3 pain+rebut bullets, 2 qualifying Qs, and a routing hint (how to mark lead). Drafting now.

Jules: Webinar plan: open with a 30s customer microcase, then demo a p95 chart and a throughput slide. Need 3 soundbites formatted for slides and tweetable lines.

OpsBot: Routing: we can do prioritized intent tagging and a confidence score. Provide regex and queue names; we log payload and match reason.

Ibrahim: Proposed routing rules (priority order):
```
- id: sdr_bench
  pattern: ".*benchmark|latency|p50|p95|throughput|cost per token|unit economics"
  queue: sdr-bench
  priority: 100
- id: ae_enterprise
  pattern: ".*SLA|enterprise|private deployment|VPC|dedicated|reserved capacity"
  queue: ae-enterprise
  priority: 80
- id: solutions
  pattern: ".*on-prem|air-gapped|HSM|compliance|HIPAA|SOC 2"
  queue: solutions
  priority: 90
```

bench-bot: benchmark upload (2026-06-04). Highlights: "~22% lower p50 vs CloudX on dedicated pools (quant Q3)" and "~1.35x throughput at 4k context under continuous batching." Full methodology: https://drive.redwood/benchmarks/2026-june. Add methodology caveat to external claims.

Clara: LegalBot wants the exact caveat line: "Measured on dedicated pools; config: quant Q3; methodology: https://drive.redwood/benchmarks/2026-june" appended to any public soundbite. We'll include it on the one-pager and slides.

Bea: Battlecard zingers (first pass):
- CloudX: "Large model catalog, but dynamic pricing and variance in tail latency." -> Rebut: "Unified runtime with batching + caching to stabilize unit economics and meet latency SLOs."
- LLMAPI: "Easy API access; limited deployment parity and observability." -> Rebut: "Same API for hosted, dedicated, and private, plus token-level cost and latency breakdowns."
- InfraCo: "DIY infra control, heavy ops burden." -> Rebut: "Managed inference runtime + migration playbook and private control plane option for regulated customers."

Ibrahim: Add two quick objection scripts (one-liners):
- "We're already on CloudX": "Fair  many start there; we reduce cost variance and operational toil without a big re-architecture."
- "We self-host with InfraCo": "Our private deployment gives you the control you have today plus a runtime tuned for production LLM economics and migration support."

Jules: Webinar soundbites:
- p50: "~22% lower p50 vs CloudX on dedicated pools (quant Q3)."
- p95: "p95 improvements depend on batching; show canary config for demo."
- throughput: "~1.35x throughput at 4k context under continuous batching."
Include the LegalBot caveat under each. Also prepare a 30s customer microstory: "Customer X replaced ad-hoc endpoints with dedicated pools, saw p50 drop ~20% and rollback incidents fall 50% during rollout."

LegalBot: Confirmed: use precise caveat string from Clara. No other modifications.

Clara: SDR cheat (draft excerpt):
Opener: "Redwood Inference: predictable inference economics and one API across hosted, dedicated, and private."
Pain + rebut (examples):
- "Latency spikes at tail" -> "We stabilize tail with batching, cache, and fallback policies."
- "Unpredictable token costs" -> "We provide unit-econ controls and visibility to lower variance."
- "No parity between dev and prod" -> "Same API across environments; easy rollouts and A/Bing of model versions."
Qualifiers: "Are you running dedicated pools or managed endpoints? Any SLA/latency targets?"
Routing hint: "Tag lead with 'bench' if they mention latency/cost/throughput."
Caveat line appended at bottom.

OpsBot: Staging plan: push routing rules to staging now, run 48h traffic replay, require false-positive < 4% before promote. Will emit smoke report.

Bea: Action items: @Ibrahim finalize zingers by 11:30 PT; @Clara finalize SDR cheat + attach caveat by 12:30 PT; @Jules produce webinar soundbites and slides by 14:00 PT; @OpsBot run staging replay and report by EOD. We'll review copy at 14:30. Thanks team :sparkles:
